artworks.title: Three Cherubs and Two Boys on Clouds
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after Peeter van Avont
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows five cherubic figures seated and engaging with each other in various poses. Each figure has a cherubic face, curly hair, and delicate wings on their backs. They are depicted in the nude against a cloudy background, giving the impression of sitting on clouds. The setting is minimalistic with a clear sky, creating a serene scene.

artworks.title: The Bridge over the Waterfall
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Jacques d' Artois
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a landscape with trees and water. The view is low, facing a river or stream towards a forested area. The horizon is mid-level, showing tree tops against the sky. In the distance, a structure is partly visible. The etching technique includes detailed line work for texture in trees and water. The color scheme is monochromatic with black, gray, and white. The foreground has detailed rocks and vegetation, leading to a denser forest. Clouds subtly move across the sky.

artworks.title: Harry Kelly's, Putney
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This image depicts a riverside scene with a low horizon, showing a townscape in the distance. The drawing style features fine etching lines for detail. Small boats with figures are in the foreground, while buildings including a church with a clock tower and a sign that reads "CROWN" are visible in the background. The sky has cloud patterns and birds. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Louis Hector, duc de Villars
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 14 x 9 cm (5 1/2 x 3 9/16 in.) (cut to platemark)
mount: 25.1 x 19.8 cm (9 7/8 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a person with their right arm bent and raised, resting on armor. The individual has curly hair down to their shoulders, a prominent nose, and slightly upturned lips. They are wearing elaborate clothing resembling a mix of robe, cape, and armor, and accessories including a star on the chest and a medallion hanging from a ribbon around the neck. The background is textured with no distinct features, and the portrait is framed in a rectangular border with a white space below containing floral and scroll motifs.

artworks.title: Jeanne d'Arc: La Pucelle d'Orléans
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy, after Lucas Cranach the Elder (attributed to)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.7 x 8.9 cm (6 3/16 x 3 1/2 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a sword with her right arm raised. She has long hair, a detailed hat, and is wearing a gown with intricate designs. The background features dense foliage and there is text at the bottom identifying her as "Jeanne d'Arc" and "La Pucelle d'Orleans."

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a valley surrounded by steep rock formations. The horizon is hidden by mountains and hills leading into the distance. The background has clouds. The scene is detailed, showing rock textures and vegetation. The color scheme is grey, emphasizing contrast and shadow. In the foreground, there is a figure by a stone cross. In the distance, there is a winding path through a gorge.

artworks.title: The Holy Kinship
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts various figures within a detailed artwork. In the center, there is a figure seated at an elevated position, holding a child with curly hair. Around them are other figures with different expressions and attire. An angelic figure with large wings stands out, holding a bouquet of lilies. An elder man and another figure reach towards the child, who holds a palm branch. At the bottom, a cherubic child with a curly hairstyle holds an item near a vase. The setting appears to be within a structure, with architectural elements like columns, and a partially visible landscape with a tree and mountains in the background. Shadows and intricate linework provide depth throughout the image.

artworks.title: Farmyard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene with a pond, a watermill, and a thatched-roof house, all intricately detailed in a traditional etching style. The composition includes trees, clouds, and a figure on a balcony. The color palette is primarily shades of gray, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Apothéose de Voltaire (The Apotheosis of Voltaire)
artworks.medium: color stipple etching with watercolor on cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with a winged figure and a horse. The composition features a central figure with wings rising against a backdrop of clouds and rays of light. The figure stands atop a horse amid the clouds. Below, two other figures appear, with one looking towards the ascending figure and another reaching upwards. The scene is encapsulated within a circular border. The detailed drawing and classical themes suggest an allegorical ascent or transformation.

artworks.title: The Surgeon
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 11.8 x 7.5 cm (4 5/8 x 2 15/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two men in early Renaissance attire. One man is seated, leaning back against a chair, while the other man stands behind him, performing an action over his head. The standing man appears elderly with a beard, hat, and glasses, wearing a fur-collared garment. The seated man looks disheveled with tousled hair, wearing a lined shirt and loose-fitting trousers. The background is textured, with a dark arching top, and a bowl or basin is nearby. The engraving is dated "1524" and features intricate hatching details.

artworks.title: Presentation in the Temple
artworks.artist: Jacques de Bie after Maarten de Vos
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a room with stone arches and columns. In the foreground, a man is holding a baby close to his face on a raised platform. Around them, several other individuals are gathered. A man with a long beard is holding a basket, another man wears a cap and robe, and a kneeling woman looks up towards the baby. A seated woman gestures towards the baby on a chair, with a cloth covering her hair, and an open book in her lap. In the background, various figures are engaged in different activities. The room has a checkered floor pattern, adding structure to the setting, and the lighting highlights the arches and columns.

artworks.title: The Repentant Magdalene in a Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated position. The horizon is low in the composition, offering a wide view of the sky with clouds and birds. Close by, there is a rocky area with foliage and two figures on top. In the distance, there are mountains. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating a fine texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Saint Paul and Saint Anthony by the Entrance to the Cave
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 25.1 x 33 cm (9 7/8 x 13 in.) (cut within platemark)
mount: 26.2 x 33.9 cm (10 5/16 x 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon line, showcasing a vast natural scene. In the foreground, a group of people are gathered under a rocky overhang with a thatched shelter. The terrain features hills and trees of varying height and density. A bird is seen flying in the sky filled with wispy clouds. The scene is depicted using etching techniques with cross-hatched lines to define textures and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, creating contrast and emphasizing the detail of the illustration.

artworks.title: Jan Six
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the image. In the center is an elderly man with a white wig, looking to his left. To his left is a woman with a helmet and layered robes. To his right is a cherubic child standing near a lion skin. The background shows drapery and an allegorical figure in the top right corner holding a shield. The scene is detailed in a classical style with the figures sitting on a stone structure.

artworks.title: Girl in a Plumed Hat
artworks.artist: Hendrick Bary after Gerard ter Borch the Younger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a waist-up portrait of a person seated with their body angled slightly to the side, looking off to the viewer's left. The person has curly hair that falls around their face, partially obscured by a large, soft hat adorned with a large feather on one side. The individual's facial features include a youthful appearance with a focused, contemplative expression. They are dressed in a voluminous gown with prominently large sleeves, and their hands rest on their lap, holding a piece of fabric. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a textured area that transitions from darker to lighter tones. The lower part of the image includes text in a script font.

artworks.title: Catherine d'Arragon (Catherine of Aragon)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Vermeulen after Adriaen van der Werff
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 31 x 17.7 cm (12 3/16 x 6 15/16 in.) (cut within platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a woman within an ornate oval frame. She is facing slightly to her left with a direct gaze. Her facial features include a round face with soft features and a small mouth, with hair hidden under an elaborate headdress adorned with pearls. She wears a detailed dress with embroidery and pearls, and a pearl necklace. Two cherubic figures are depicted above and flanking the oval frame. The background includes architectural elements and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Gellius de Bouma
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man from the waist up, seated in a chair. He is positioned facing the viewer with his right arm resting on the armrest of his chair and his left hand holding a piece of fabric in his lap. The man has a white beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, and a high forehead. His hair is short and covered by a cap. He is wearing a dark, full-sleeved garment with buttons down the front, and a large ruffed collar. A bracelet is visible on his left wrist. On a table around him, several books, writing implements, including a quill, are laid out. The background is a textured, dark surface that contrasts with his clothing and skin, drawing attention to his presence.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen the Younger, Cornelis Jonson van Ceulen, Clement de Jonghe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of Anna Maria van Schurman, depicting her from the waist up in a frontal position. She has a calm expression, slightly arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. Her hair is styled away from her face with curls around her ears and neck. She wears a draped garment with voluminous sleeves and holds a small object in her raised right hand. The other hand rests near her waist. The portrait is in an oval frame with her name. Cherubs on either side of the frame and a church tower in the background are visible. Mathematical instruments are incorporated into the border design.

artworks.title: Johannes Hoornbeeck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a mustache, expressive eyebrows, dark wavy hair, and is dressed in formal attire. He is holding a book in his right hand close to his chest. The background features a textured pattern and includes text at the bottom identifying the man as "IOHANNES HOORNBECK."

artworks.title: Gaspar de Gusman, Count of Olivares
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens, after Diego Velázquez
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the shoulders up within an ornate frame. He is shown in full face wearing a historical military uniform with a high collar and design elements suggesting armor. The frame features intricate details including scrollwork, laurel leaves, and various instruments. Flanking the frame are two cherubic figures, with one holding a shield adorned with a face. Fantastical creatures resembling lions or dragons are positioned behind them. Above the portrait is an emblem with a star, wings, and ribbons. The background contains classical motifs such as feathers, plants, and clusters of fruits set against a richly textured pattern.

artworks.title: Hamlet in a Valley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view from an elevated point. Fields, trees, and small buildings can be seen stretching into the distance. The horizon line is positioned just above the midpoint of the image, where distant hills meet the sky. The intricate etching technique used in this piece showcases fine lines detailing natural elements and structures. The sky is filled with clouds depicted with sweeping lines. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray and black creating depth. Closest to us, there is a cluster of houses and a wooden fence, leading the eye through layers of fields and trees to the distant hills.

artworks.title: A Village on a Hill
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line. The area is gently rolling with vegetation, a windmill on the horizon, a large detailed tree on the right, and a building with steep roofs and chimneys partially hidden by the tree. The style is precise etching with attention to texture and contour. The color palette is black and white with strong contrast for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Watermill at the Foot of a Hill
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with various elements. The view is slightly from above, allowing a detailed scene. The horizon is low, with the sky in the upper half. There is a building with a water wheel on the left, surrounded by trees. Rolling hills and trees are in the middle distance, creating a boundary as the land slopes to the right. In the background, distant hills rise on the left, with a hint of a hilltop. The brushstrokes are fine, detailing textures in foliage and structures. The color palette is sepia, giving a historical feel to the scene.

artworks.title: A Wooden and a Stone Bridge
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.2 x 20.3 cm (6 x 8 in.)
sheet: 15.2 x 20.6 cm (6 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a stone bridge crossing a stream. Rocks and water are visible near the stream's edge. A pair of trees with detailed branches is on the right, while buildings, including a church, are seen further back. Hills mark the horizon, and the sky is filled with clouds. The artwork predominantly uses a monochrome color palette.
